# bronto_sso_mappings (Resource)

Manages the full set of Bronto SSO mappings (identity provider attribute values mapped to Bronto roles or groups) for the organization. This is a singleton: only one `bronto_sso_mappings` resource should be declared per org.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This is a singleton: declare exactly one bronto_sso_mappings resource per
# org. It manages the organization's whole list of SSO mappings at once.
resource "bronto_sso_mappings" "this" {
  mappings = [
    {
      provider_key   = "member_of"
      provider_value = "Developers"
      assign_attr    = "Standard"
    },
    {
      provider_key   = "member_of"
      provider_value = "Admins"
      assign_attr    = "Admin"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mappings` (Attributes List) The full list of SSO mappings for the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mappings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A constant identifier for this singleton resource.

<a id="nestedatt--mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mappings`

Required:

- `assign_attr` (String) The Bronto role or group to assign when `provider_key`/`provider_value` matches.
- `provider_key` (String) The identity provider attribute key to read the value from, e.g. `member_of`.
- `provider_value` (String) The identity provider attribute value to match, e.g. `Developers`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# This is a singleton resource - the id is always the constant
# "sso_mappings".
terraform import bronto_sso_mappings.this sso_mappings

# Alternatively, the Bronto API can generate a ready-to-paste
# bronto_sso_mappings block (including its own `import` block) for the
# org's existing mappings directly:
#   GET /sso/mappings/export?format=terraform
```
